title: Keyturn Host Protection Plan: Opening a Damage Claim on an Enrolment
content:
A claim is opened on an enrolment at a provisional figure, which is what the marketplace puts on the loss before anything is appraised. A claim is opened on a loss only after a damage report for that trip stands on the register carrying the number of photographs and documents the plan asks of it. The claim stands against the Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment covering the vehicle and against the trip the loss happened on.

### Situation of use and capability

`open_loss_claim_e6dccf7d` writes a new claim record against the enrolment carrying the day the loss happened, the kind of damage, the estimate reference the host quotes and the amount the claim is opened at, and stamps it with today's date and an undetermined liability finding. The host can afterwards see the claim and its reference standing against that trip.

### How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk agent, who works out the provisional figure and passes it in; the tool itself judges nothing.

### Parameters

- `enrollment_id` — the reference number of the host protection enrolment the claim is made under, read from the enrolment record retrieved for this host.
- `booking_id` — the reference number of the trip booking the loss happened on, read from the trip record retrieved for that vehicle.
- `damage_category` — the kind of loss being claimed, one of `exterior_body`, `interior`, `glass`, `tyres_wheels`, `mechanical`, `theft_total_loss`, `missing_equipment` and `third_party_property`, being respectively damage to the outside of the vehicle, to upholstery, trim or fittings inside the cabin, to windscreen, window or mirror glass, to tyres, rims or wheels, a mechanical breakdown or driveline failure arising on the trip, a stolen vehicle or one damaged beyond economic repair, equipment removed from the vehicle, and damage the guest caused to property belonging to someone else.
- `loss_date` — the calendar day the damage occurred, written as YYYY-MM-DD in the marketplace's own local dating with no time part; it is never left blank.
- `settlement_reference` — the repair estimate, invoice or report reference the host reads out for this loss, copied character for character from what the host says, keeping the original wording, digits, letter case and punctuation, with nothing translated, normalised, summarised, added or removed.
- `claim_opened_amount` — the amount the claim is opened at, in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half-up to the cent at the moment the claim is opened.

### Return

A confirmation line in plain text carrying the reference number of the new claim record, the trip it belongs to and the amount it was opened at in USD to the cent. Receiving that line means the claim now stands on the enrolment; no other output is produced.
